g.aria-label: Static Pre-Allocated Cache Buffer (B, H_kv, T_max, d_h) per Block
Why Static Shapes + In-Place Writes Are Mandatory for Fast Compilation
1. Dynamic torch.cat inside a token loop reallocates memory and forces JIT recompilation every step.
2. Fixed buffer address + RoPE offset t + boolean mask (idx ≤ t) lets CUDA Graphs / XLA compile once!
